# DPA-SDT
> Document partnership agreements, connect self-declarations, and track ERC-721 participation packages.

## About
Private source repository for a partnership workspace: local agreement drafts, EOA EIP-712 acceptance, thirteen-field SDT commitments, exclusive ERC-721 packages, and read-only historical declaration reports. Creation uses fictional fixtures and test ETH; the separate verifier processes original field strings locally without authenticating identity or banking activity. Public compiled sites are maintained separately; this checkout does not publish them automatically.

- Author: Maxim Osovsky — https://www.linkedin.com/in/osovsky/
- URL: https://github.com/maximosovsky/DPA-SDT
- License: no repository-wide grant; contract UNLICENSED and scoped site-content CC BY 4.0 notices retained
- Checks: npm test 234 passing / 0 failing; npm run test:hash 4 passing / 0 failing; npm run build passed
- Workflow: in test-deployment/, npm ci; npx playwright install chromium; npm run build; npm run dev -- --port 4173 --strictPort
